name: A Promise Best Left Unkept - Aya Edition
source:
Prompted into action by the promise he made to his girlfriend a year ago, Harry finally made a huge breakthrough in his quest for success by scoring a major deal for his company, in doing so setting into motion his inevitable promotion. But what he didn’t foresee is that the byproduct of his unshakable resolve would unintentionally invite an undesirable presence into his life. The representative of the subcontracting company—his old bully from high school.​

At a certain point early in the game, Harry will be doing something different than what he did in the original version, and this will lead to a drastically different outcome.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/HangoverCat]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一年前，哈利对女友做出的承诺促使他采取行动，最终在他追求成功的道路上取得了巨大突破，为公司达成了一项重大交易，从而启动了他不可避免的晋升。但他没有预见到的是，他不可动摇的决心的副产品会无意中邀请一个不受欢迎的人进入他的生活。分包公司的代表——他高中时的老恶霸。​

在游戏早期的某个时刻，哈利会做一些与原始版本中不同的事情，这将导致完全不同的结果。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/HangoverCat]Patreon[/url]]
